## Minimal Tyrannosaurus (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
Variant tyrannosaurus  
N Small animal  
**Init** +7; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +37  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 99 (18d8+18)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +16, **Will** +10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +20 (1d6+6/19-20 plus grab)  
**Special Attacks** swallow whole (1d6+3 damage, AC 17, 11 hp)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 21, **Con** 11, **Int** 2, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +15 (+19 grapple); **CMD** 30  
**Feats** Bleeding Critical, Critical Focus, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +5 (+9 to jump), Perception +37; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  
**SQ** powerful bite Languages –  


**Special Abilities**



**Powerful Bite (Ex)** This creature applies twice its Strength bonus to bite damage.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm forest and plains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or pack (3–6)  
**Treasure** none
